svg.text: Figure 3: Phylodynamic & Surveillance Benchmarks — LASSO50-Greedy vs. Stride-Matched SURS
LASSO50-Greedy (50 macro-subgroups) beats SURS across 10 state-regime runs (exp1+exp3) and cuts exp1<->exp3 flow regime drift |ΔCos| by up to 3.9x.
A. Phylogeographic Flow Reconstruction: LASSO50-Greedy vs. SURS
exp3 state dots & 5-state mean bars: Topological F1 (purple) & Cosine (blue)
1S-1_LL-P wins 10/10 runs on F1 (+5.4%) & 8/10 on Cosine (+1.1%) with highest 10-run floor (0.591).
4S-P & 1S-P win 9/10 runs on F1 (13/14 incl. preQC), discovering rural-urban bridges SURS misses.
B. Multi-Objective & Cross-Regime Resilience Scorecard (LASSO50-Greedy vs. SURS)
exp3 gain (%), 10-run win record (exp1+exp3, ● >= 9/10), and exp1<->exp3 regime drift |ΔCos|
LASSO50-Greedy (P & LL-P) wins 10/10 runs on Senior 65+ & Adult Tree MRD and 9-10/10 on Flow F1 & Clusters.
SURS · 4S drifts by |ΔCos| = 0.096 between exp1 & exp3; LASSO50-Greedy · 4S-P drifts by just 0.025 (3.9x more stable).
